Valid PAN and GST registration; joint ventures and consortium not permitted
Valid registration of appropriate class and category (civil) in central/state govt department/undertaking
Not blacklisted/debarred declaration; unconditional price bid undertaking; tender acceptance letter
Bank solvency certificate of at least 40% of estimated cost, not older than 1 year
Average annual turnover (2021-22 to 2023-24) at least 30% of estimated cost, CA certified
